replaces.idea: A post-mounted EPT violation trip-breaker box with a tripped bright-green toggle lever.
A two-stage geared translation machine on a pedestal with two meshed index wheels.
A socketed processor cartridge with vertical heatsink fins seated in a floor-mounted dock.
A mechanical parking-meter-style steal-time gauge on a slender floor post.
A bench-mounted twin-housing belt-drive chute passing capsules between guest and host.
A pedestal-mounted rotary telegraph dial with a pointer needle for VM-exit reasons.

new.name: Virtio Belt Chute
new.depicts: Two low dark-green housings bolted to a wide bench, linked by an exposed horizontal conveyor belt carrying a bright-green capsule.
new.focal: The bright-green capsule riding the horizontal belt between the two housings

new.name: EPT Gear Translator
new.depicts: A pedestal-mounted mechanical translator housing two meshed toothed wheels side by side behind a cutaway front plate.

new.name: SR-IOV Manifold
new.concept: Single Root I/O Virtualization (physical device slicing)
new.depicts: A heavy dark-green pipe trunk rising from a floor flange into a horizontal manifold block with four smaller upright nozzles.
new.focal: The four bright-green-tipped nozzles branching from one trunk

new.name: Posted-IRQ Annunciator
new.depicts: A wall-mounted rectangular annunciator cabinet with three small shuttered windows and a bright-green drop flag in the middle slot.

new.name: vCPU Cartridge
new.depicts: A compact upright processor cartridge with four vertical heatsink fins seated in a notched floor socket.

new.name: Steal-Time Meter
new.depicts: A slender floor post topped by a rounded meter head with a semi-circular dial face and a bright-green needle.
new.focal: The bright-green needle on the rounded meter head

new.name: VM-Exit MSR Dial
new.depicts: A stout squat pedestal supporting a round brass-style rotary selector dial with a bright-green pointer knob.
new.focal: The bright-green pointer knob on the circular dial

new.name: EPT Trip Breaker
new.depicts: A small post-mounted breaker box with a hinged front cover and a bright-green toggle lever snapped to the tripped position.

rework.redesign: Redraw as a heavy industrial airlock gate with a floor threshold plate, riveted side stanchions, and a glowing bright-green status beacon mounted on the lintel.
Redraw as a wheeled server canister being winched along an overhead rail between two floor-mounted docking pedestals.
